dedupe_keys.name: statistical institute of belize census 2022 housing tables on dwelling type outer wall roofing and flooring material year built repairs needed tenure and rooms by district and urban and rural area

description: The Statistical Institute of Belize released the housing results of the 2022 Population and Housing Census as an Excel workbook on its census page. Coverage is national: thirteen tables give counts of dwellings and households by district and by urban and rural area: dwelling type, material of outer walls, roofing material, flooring material, the year the dwelling was built, the level of repairs needed, tenure of the dwelling and of the land, and the number of rooms and bedrooms. Two tables cross repairs needed with wall material and construction period, which ties building condition to building type. For example, the dwelling type table lists 2,615 undivided private houses in urban Corozal. Format and access: a single XLSX file, free to download with no registration. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the finest geography is district by urban and rural, so there are only eighteen rows per table; the general characteristics workbook read on the same page had no water, electricity or toilet tables, so utility access is not covered here; the 2010 census REDATAM portal link on the SIB site redirected when tried. Simulation uses: hurricane and flood exposure models that need the mix of wall and roof materials and building age per district, and housing repair needs for recovery planning. Related records: the ECLAC REDATAM hub, which lists Caribbean census databases.

schema_summary: One sheet per table. H1 dwelling type; H2 material of outer walls; H3 roofing material; H4 flooring material; H5 year dwelling was built; H6 level of repairs; H7 tenure of dwelling; H8 tenure of land; H9 and H10 repairs needed by outer wall material and year built; H11 households by rooms; H12 households by bedrooms; H13 bedrooms by household size. Rows are district by urban, rural and total; columns are categories.
